subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 3: /m/ (mat, man, mop, met); differentiates m and n; segments oral sentences into words

show.line: Listen. m, m, mat. Mmm, yummy! Mat starts with m.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with m, as in mat?
Say the sound with me. m, as in man!
Is it m or n? Listen. Man.
Listen. m, a, n. What word is it?
Does it start with m or n? Sort the pictures.

hints: Close your lips and hum. m, m, m.
m has lips closed. n has lips open.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with m.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Nest starts with n. Mop starts with m.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. m, m, mop. Mop starts with m!

parent_line: Can hear the m sound and tell it apart from n.
